lore: DiskSaver Island's hot pool berths only so many island caches; the home cache never leaves. Each tide an island asks to stream in. The harbour posts a tide chart of who comes next: clear the berth needed last, and the stalls stay low.

lines.start: Tide chart's posted. Read it before you clear a berth.
lines.miss: Not in the pool. The island stalls while it streams in.
lines.evict: Berth cleared. Pick the one the chart needs last.
lines.win: Season's done and the stalls stayed in budget. Good reading.
lines.fail: Too many stalls. The islands queue at the harbour mouth.
